summary: Alaska Air Group, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, announcing the launch of a private offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2031 by its subsidiary Alaska Airlines. The notes are senior unsecured obligations guaranteed by the parent company. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The offering is exempt from registration under Rule 144A and Regulation S. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No deal terms are included.
